evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies `src/node/miner.cpp`, `src/interfaces/mining.h`, and `src/node/tx_collection.cpp`.
rationale: Adds the `TxCollection` interface to enable external mining coordinators like Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers to reconstruct and validate block templates efficiently without duplicate mempool mirrors. As noted in the PR description, callers previously had to maintain their own mempools by repeatedly polling templates, and this interface directly addresses that overhead for decentralized mining setups while integrating with external Stratum v2 tooling.
